attchmntText: Bhageria Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Bhageria Industries Limited has received the Attestation of Good Manufacturing Practice inspection approval from the European Directorate for the Quality of Medicines and HealthCare for its manufacturing facility in Vapi, Gujarat. The inspection took place from February 4, 2026 to February 6, 2026. This approval relates to the manufacture of Dexamethasone under Certificate of Suitability number 2024-138. The attestation confirms compliance with European Good Manufacturing Practice requirements under the Certificate of Suitability framework. The company filed this intimation with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Bhageria Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates regarding Newspaper Publication of Financial result for September 30, 2026
Bhageria Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
